full_page.content:
1935, March
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 312
Mar. 1 Mrs. Trump - 55 - bad breast ...
Anna Sentdion - about 40 - fell and dislocated knee - 7 months on crutches. Rose Cowan - 47 - nerveous
4 Cha's Sweeney - 17 ... See Nov. 8 ... still deaf.
5 David Cunningham - Episcopelian - operation expected to-morrow for Stomach-ulcers. Operation once before ... now worse.
Chain Prayer ....
Kathy Kranibus - 14 - eye infection - the fear -loss of it. April 7th reported as seeing.
12 Wanda Turszynske - 17 - in an institution paralysed & helpless .. ... enrolled to-day by charitable visitor.
Albert Mardney - 5 - home from Hosp. to die leakage of heart after fearful case of whooping cough ..... Father not to communion for years ... wept when asked how many years away. Promised to go soon.
Page 313 Blank Page
Page 314
Mar. 12 June Knapp - 5 - measles & threatened mastoid.
12 Addison E, Holliday - methodist ( ?...? ) - 46 - very peculiar ailment - now in hospital with tubes in lungs and stomach - Six doctors baffled as to real cause or effect ...
12 Geo. Oley - 10 - quite hard of hearing
12 John W. Miller - 71 - cancer-operation in Ford's .... Convert.
12 James Lenney - 4 - operation this a.m. not tumor on brain as was feared, but fluid, drained ... very critical.
13 Raymond Romanski - 24 - stomach ulcers
Mrs. Van Winkel
Osca Richard - suicide ?....
Margaret Yager - 33 - threaten ... operation for cancer of breast a- verted - lump vanished ... Deo
